title: Mirepoix
description: A classic French aromatic vegetable base made from onion, carrot, and celery, used to build depth of flavor in stocks, soups, sauces, stews, braises, and roasts.

ingredients.title: Classic Mirepoix
items: Onion – 2 parts (about 50% of the mix), diced
Carrot – 1 part (about 25% of the mix), diced
Celery – 1 part (about 25% of the mix), diced
Butter or olive oil – 1 tbsp (optional, for sweating)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Wash and peel the vegetables if necessary.
Dice the onion, carrot, and celery into uniform pieces to ensure even cooking.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sweat the Mirepoix
steps: Heat butter or olive oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over low to medium heat.
Add the diced vegetables and cook gently for 5–10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Do not allow the vegetables to brown unless the recipe specifically requires caramelization.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Use in Cooking
steps: Add the mirepoix to stocks, soups, sauces, braises, stews, or roasts as the flavor base.
For traditional French stocks, combine the mirepoix with a bouquet garni to create a rich, balanced aromatic foundation.

chefTips: Maintain the classic French 2:1:1 ratio of onion, carrot, and celery for balanced flavor.
Sweat the vegetables gently to extract sweetness without browning.
Cut all vegetables into uniform pieces for even cooking and flavor extraction.
Pair mirepoix with a bouquet garni for authentic Continental and French cooking.
